risk_notes: The dominant risk on this unit is store routing, not code: ab02e15a and fd7737ec are in the ROOT ticket store while every session-store ticket from the prior units is in the memory-api store. A wrong workspace argument produces a misleading 'no ticket found' error that reads like the ticket does not exist. This already caused a false 'the chain is phantom' conclusion once in the previous session. Beyond that: ab02e15a touches SessionRecord, which every existing on-disk session deserializes into, so the new fields must be genuinely optional with serde defaults or every prior session fails to load. Verify against real committed sessions under .session/sessions/, not only fresh tempdir stores.
